# HELP flakeradar_reports Reports by current status.
# TYPE flakeradar_reports gauge
flakeradar_reports{status="pending"} 0
flakeradar_reports{status="processed"} 0
flakeradar_reports{status="failed"} 0
# HELP flakeradar_oldest_pending_report_age_seconds Age in seconds of the oldest pending Report; 0 when the queue is empty.
# TYPE flakeradar_oldest_pending_report_age_seconds gauge
flakeradar_oldest_pending_report_age_seconds 0.0
# HELP flakeradar_processor_leader 1 when a process holds the Report processor advisory lock.
# TYPE flakeradar_processor_leader gauge
flakeradar_processor_leader 1
# HELP flakeradar_tests Tests by tier (flaky, suspect, stable).
# TYPE flakeradar_tests gauge
flakeradar_tests{tier="flaky"} 0
flakeradar_tests{tier="suspect"} 0
flakeradar_tests{tier="stable"} 0
# HELP flakeradar_jobs Jobs by tier (flaky, suspect, stable).
# TYPE flakeradar_jobs gauge
flakeradar_jobs{tier="flaky"} 0
flakeradar_jobs{tier="suspect"} 0
flakeradar_jobs{tier="stable"} 0
# HELP flakeradar_last_report_processed_timestamp_seconds Unix time of the most recently processed Report still retained; absent until the first Report is processed, and it can move backwards or disappear again once retention deletes processed Reports (REPORT_RETENTION_DAYS).
# TYPE flakeradar_last_report_processed_timestamp_seconds gauge
